name: @ncsound/dj-engine
description: Party DJ's mixing engine, running headless. Renders the Web Audio graph on the server and publishes PCM to Liquidsoap.

scripts.//test: Every test here renders audio in real time and owns a headless AudioContext with its own audio thread. bun's default --max-concurrency is 20, so twenty of those compete for one machine and the assertions about rendered level start failing at random: three consecutive runs gave 29 pass/0 fail, 24/5 and 25/4, with a different set of failures each time. Serialising costs wall-clock and buys a result you can trust.
